-- Android 归因离线测算 · JHG-102 · T-1=2026-11-09
-- 口径：注册 channel 一律按空入围；落地页候选限定 channel=ahwklkwm；打分沿用现网 default 配置

WITH reg_base AS (
  SELECT
    r.dt, r.app_id, r.uid, r.event_id AS register_event_id, r.event_time AS register_event_time,
    r.ip AS reg_ip,
    r.device_brand AS reg_brand, r.device_model AS reg_model,
    r.system_name AS reg_system, r.system_version AS reg_system_version,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(r.device_brand)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(r.device_brand)) END AS reg_brand_clean,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(r.device_model)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(r.device_model)) END AS reg_model_clean,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(r.system_name)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(r.system_name)) END AS reg_system_clean,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(r.system_version)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(r.system_version)) END AS reg_system_version_clean,
    r.channel AS actual_reg_channel
  FROM dwd.dwd_user_register_d_v2 r
  WHERE r.dt = '2026-11-09'
    AND r.app_id = 'JHG-102'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(r.device)) = 'android'
    AND r.uid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(r.uid) <> ''
),
time_conf AS (
  SELECT max_seconds, score
  FROM dim.dim_app_attribution_time_config
  WHERE app_id='default' AND COALESCE(is_active,1)=1
),
click_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    r.register_event_id, r.uid, r.register_event_time, r.reg_ip,
    r.reg_brand, r.reg_model, r.reg_system, r.reg_system_version,
    r.reg_brand_clean, r.reg_model_clean, r.reg_system_clean, r.reg_system_version_clean,
    r.actual_reg_channel,
    c.event_id AS src_id, 'landing_page_click' AS src_type, c.channel AS src_channel, c.event_time AS src_time,
    c.ip AS hit_ip, c.device_brand AS hit_brand, c.device_model AS hit_model,
    c.system_name AS hit_system, c.system_version AS hit_system_version,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(c.device_brand)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(c.device_brand)) END AS hit_brand_clean,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(c.device_model)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(c.device_model)) END AS hit_model_clean,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(c.system_name)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(c.system_name)) END AS hit_system_clean,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(c.system_version)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(c.system_version)) END AS hit_system_version_clean,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.event_time, r.register_event_time) AS time_diff_seconds
  FROM reg_base r
  INNER JOIN dwd.dwd_landing_page_click_d c
    ON r.app_id = c.app_id AND r.reg_ip = c.ip
  WHERE c.dt BETWEEN '2026-11-08' AND '2026-11-09'
    AND c.event_time < r.register_event_time
    AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, c.event_time, r.register_event_time) <= 86400
    AND c.channel = 'ahwklkwm'
),
view_candidates AS (
  SELECT
    r.register_event_id, r.uid, r.register_event_time, r.reg_ip,
    r.reg_brand, r.reg_model, r.reg_system, r.reg_system_version,
    r.reg_brand_clean, r.reg_model_clean, r.reg_system_clean, r.reg_system_version_clean,
    r.actual_reg_channel,
    v.event_id AS src_id, 'landing_page_view' AS src_type, v.channel AS src_channel, v.event_time AS src_time,
    v.ip AS hit_ip, v.device_brand AS hit_brand, v.device_model AS hit_model,
    v.system_name AS hit_system, v.system_version AS hit_system_version,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(v.device_brand)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(v.device_brand)) END AS hit_brand_clean,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(v.device_model)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(v.device_model)) END AS hit_model_clean,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(v.system_name)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(v.system_name)) END AS hit_system_clean,
    CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(v.system_version)) IN ('','unknown','null','none','undefined') THEN NULL ELSE LOWER(TRIM(v.system_version)) END AS hit_system_version_clean,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, v.event_time, r.register_event_time) AS time_diff_seconds
  FROM reg_base r
  INNER JOIN dwd.dwd_landing_page_view_d v
    ON r.app_id = v.app_id AND r.reg_ip = v.ip
  WHERE v.dt BETWEEN '2026-11-08' AND '2026-11-09'
    AND v.event_time < r.register_event_time
    AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, v.event_time, r.register_event_time) <= 86400
    AND v.channel = 'ahwklkwm'
),
click_scored AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
      cc.*,
      COALESCE(tc.score,0) AS score_time,
      tc.max_seconds AS time_bucket_max_seconds,
      CASE WHEN cc.reg_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_brand_clean=cc.hit_brand_clean THEN 10 ELSE 0 END AS score_brand,
      CASE WHEN cc.reg_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_model_clean=cc.hit_model_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS score_model,
      CASE WHEN cc.reg_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_system_clean=cc.hit_system_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS score_system,
      CASE WHEN cc.reg_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_system_version_clean=cc.hit_system_version_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS score_system_version,
      (
        CASE WHEN cc.reg_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_brand_clean=cc.hit_brand_clean THEN 10 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN cc.reg_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_model_clean=cc.hit_model_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN cc.reg_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_system_clean=cc.hit_system_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN cc.reg_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_system_version_clean=cc.hit_system_version_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        COALESCE(tc.score,0)
      ) AS total_score,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY cc.register_event_id
        ORDER BY (
          CASE WHEN cc.reg_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_brand_clean=cc.hit_brand_clean THEN 10 ELSE 0 END +
          CASE WHEN cc.reg_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_model_clean=cc.hit_model_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
          CASE WHEN cc.reg_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_system_clean=cc.hit_system_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
          CASE WHEN cc.reg_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.hit_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND cc.reg_system_version_clean=cc.hit_system_version_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
          COALESCE(tc.score,0)
        ) DESC, cc.src_time DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM click_candidates cc
    LEFT JOIN time_conf tc ON cc.time_diff_seconds <= tc.max_seconds
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cc.register_event_id, cc.src_id ORDER BY tc.max_seconds ASC) = 1
  ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
view_scored AS (
  SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT
      vc.*,
      COALESCE(tc.score,0) AS score_time,
      tc.max_seconds AS time_bucket_max_seconds,
      CASE WHEN vc.reg_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_brand_clean=vc.hit_brand_clean THEN 10 ELSE 0 END AS score_brand,
      CASE WHEN vc.reg_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_model_clean=vc.hit_model_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS score_model,
      CASE WHEN vc.reg_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_system_clean=vc.hit_system_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS score_system,
      CASE WHEN vc.reg_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_system_version_clean=vc.hit_system_version_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END AS score_system_version,
      (
        CASE WHEN vc.reg_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_brand_clean=vc.hit_brand_clean THEN 10 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN vc.reg_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_model_clean=vc.hit_model_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN vc.reg_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_system_clean=vc.hit_system_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN vc.reg_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_system_version_clean=vc.hit_system_version_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        COALESCE(tc.score,0)
      ) AS total_score,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY vc.register_event_id
        ORDER BY (
          CASE WHEN vc.reg_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_brand_clean=vc.hit_brand_clean THEN 10 ELSE 0 END +
          CASE WHEN vc.reg_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_model_clean=vc.hit_model_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
          CASE WHEN vc.reg_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_system_clean=vc.hit_system_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
          CASE WHEN vc.reg_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.hit_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND vc.reg_system_version_clean=vc.hit_system_version_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
          COALESCE(tc.score,0)
        ) DESC, vc.src_time DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM view_candidates vc
    LEFT JOIN time_conf tc ON vc.time_diff_seconds <= tc.max_seconds
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY vc.register_event_id, vc.src_id ORDER BY tc.max_seconds ASC) = 1
  ) t WHERE rn = 1
),
final_pick AS (
  SELECT
    r.register_event_id,
    r.uid,
    r.actual_reg_channel,
    CASE
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL AND clk.total_score >= 40 THEN 'click'
      WHEN viw.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'view'
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'click'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS winner_source,
    CASE
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL AND clk.total_score >= 40 THEN clk.total_score
      WHEN viw.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN viw.total_score
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN clk.total_score
      ELSE NULL
    END AS score,
    CASE
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL AND clk.total_score >= 40 THEN clk.src_type
      WHEN viw.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN viw.src_type
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN clk.src_type
      ELSE NULL
    END AS source_event_type,
    CASE
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL AND clk.total_score >= 40 THEN clk.time_diff_seconds
      WHEN viw.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN viw.time_diff_seconds
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN clk.time_diff_seconds
      ELSE NULL
    END AS time_diff_seconds,
    CASE
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL AND clk.total_score >= 40 THEN clk.score_brand
      WHEN viw.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN viw.score_brand
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN clk.score_brand
      ELSE NULL
    END AS score_brand,
    CASE
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL AND clk.total_score >= 40 THEN clk.score_model
      WHEN viw.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN viw.score_model
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN clk.score_model
      ELSE NULL
    END AS score_model,
    CASE
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL AND clk.total_score >= 40 THEN clk.score_system
      WHEN viw.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN viw.score_system
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN clk.score_system
      ELSE NULL
    END AS score_system,
    CASE
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL AND clk.total_score >= 40 THEN clk.score_system_version
      WHEN viw.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN viw.score_system_version
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN clk.score_system_version
      ELSE NULL
    END AS score_system_version,
    CASE
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL AND clk.total_score >= 40 THEN clk.score_time
      WHEN viw.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN viw.score_time
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN clk.score_time
      ELSE NULL
    END AS score_time,
    (clk.src_id IS NOT NULL OR viw.src_id IS NOT NULL) AS has_candidate
  FROM reg_base r
  LEFT JOIN click_scored clk ON r.register_event_id = clk.register_event_id
  LEFT JOIN view_scored viw ON r.register_event_id = viw.register_event_id
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS android_reg_enroll,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_candidate_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate AND score >= 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate AND (score IS NULL OR score < 40) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fail_cnt,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0), 2) AS candidate_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate AND score >= 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0), 2) AS success_rate_pct,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate AND score >= 40 AND source_event_type='landing_page_click' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_from_click,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate AND score >= 40 AND source_event_type='landing_page_view' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_from_view,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate AND score >= 40 AND actual_reg_channel='ahwklkwm' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_actual_same_channel,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate AND score >= 40 AND (actual_reg_channel IS NULL OR TRIM(actual_reg_channel)='' OR LOWER(TRIM(actual_reg_channel)) IN ('organic','natural','self')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_actual_empty_organic
FROM final_pick;
EOF

        CASE WHEN vtb.reg_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.hit_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.reg_brand_clean=vtb.hit_brand_clean THEN 10 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN vtb.reg_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.hit_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.reg_model_clean=vtb.hit_model_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN vtb.reg_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.hit_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.reg_system_clean=vtb.hit_system_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN vtb.reg_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.hit_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.reg_system_version_clean=vtb.hit_system_version_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        COALESCE(vtb.score_time,0)
      ) AS total_score,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY vtb.register_event_id ORDER BY (
        CASE WHEN vtb.reg_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.hit_brand_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.reg_brand_clean=vtb.hit_brand_clean THEN 10 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN vtb.reg_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.hit_model_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.reg_model_clean=vtb.hit_model_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN vtb.reg_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.hit_system_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.reg_system_clean=vtb.hit_system_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN vtb.reg_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.hit_system_version_clean IS NOT NULL AND vtb.reg_system_version_clean=vtb.hit_system_version_clean THEN 20 ELSE 0 END +
        COALESCE(vtb.score_time,0)
      ) DESC, vtb.src_time DESC) AS rn
    FROM view_time_bucket vtb
  ) t WHERE rn=1
),
final_pick AS (
  SELECT
    r.actual_reg_channel,
    CASE WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL OR viw.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_candidate,
    CASE
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL AND clk.total_score >= 40 THEN clk.total_score
      WHEN viw.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN viw.total_score
      WHEN clk.src_id IS NOT NULL THEN clk.total_score
      ELSE NULL
    END AS score
  FROM reg_base r
  LEFT JOIN click_scored clk ON r.register_event_id=clk.register_event_id
  LEFT JOIN view_scored viw ON r.register_event_id=viw.register_event_id
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN actual_reg_channel='ahwklkwm' THEN 'actual_ahwklkwm'
    WHEN actual_reg_channel IS NULL OR TRIM(actual_reg_channel)='' OR LOWER(TRIM(actual_reg_channel)) IN ('organic','natural','self') THEN 'actual_empty_organic'
    ELSE 'actual_other_channel'
  END AS scope,
  COUNT(*) AS enroll,
  SUM(has_candidate) AS has_candidate_cnt,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate=1 AND score>=40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_cnt,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(has_candidate)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS candidate_rate_pct,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN has_candidate=1 AND score>=40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/NULLIF(SUM(has_candidate),0),2) AS success_rate_pct
FROM final_pick
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

在 **Android + 注册渠道按空处理 + 落地页限定 ahwklkwm** 的测试口径下：

- 有候选用户 **1,448** 人

说明：现有打分规则套到 Android 上，**一旦能对齐到该渠道落地页，过线率很高**；真正拉开差距的是「有没有候选」，不是分数门槛。

## 测试怎么定的

| 项 | 本次定法 | 说明 |
|----|---------|------|
| 设备 | Android | 现网正式归因只入围 iOS；本次专门测 Android |

用户访问落地页(ahwklkwm) → 下载/打开 App → Android 注册（本次当渠道为空）
         ↑________________ 同 IP + 24h 内 + 打分 ≥ 40 ________________↑

|------|------|------|

|---------|---------|

有候选但分数 < 40 的 68 人，全是「设备字段没和落地页对上，只剩时间分」：
